equilibrium_as_imbalance.thesis: equilibrium is NOT a static state of perfect balance.
equilibrium_as_imbalance.antithesis: equilibrium IS the dynamic state where competing imbalances balance each other.

sigmoid_midpoint.meaning: the point where all forces compete and none win. ALL print-scan styles converge here.
sigmoid_midpoint.note: 0.5 is not zero force — it is MAXIMUM competing force. both halves push equally.

iron_peak.meaning: maximum binding energy. fusion pushes from below, fission pushes from above. iron sits where they balance.
iron_peak.note: iron is not inert — it is the MOST stable because both forces are STRONGEST here.

spring_constant.cycle: the oscillation between 0.4 and 4.5 IS the equilibrium. neither state alone is equilibrium.
